headline: BTS GmbH Faces Production Standstill Amid Major Ransomware Breach
body: Bavarian component maker BTS GmbH has temporarily suspended operations following a crippling ransomware incident. Affected areas include vital manufacturing execution systems and logistics networks, causing at least one plant to cease activity. External cyber experts have been enlisted to accelerate recovery efforts. As of now, no definitive timeline for resuming full production has been shared.
